registration.title: Registration Settings
registration.envHint: Controlled by {code} env variable. Remove it to manage from UI.
registration.enabledDescription: Users can register immediately without approval.
registration.reviewDescription: Users can register but require admin approval before they can log in.
registration.disabledDescription: Registration is disabled. Only admins can create users.

oidc.title: OIDC / SSO Settings
oidc.callbackHint: Add this URL to your identity provider's allowed redirect URIs.
oidc.enabledHint: Enable OIDC authentication for single sign-on.
oidc.clientSecretHint: Leave empty for public clients (PKCE will be used automatically).
oidc.accountLinkingHint: Automatically link OIDC accounts with existing users by email.
oidc.adminGroupHint: OIDC group claim value that grants admin rights. Users in this group become admins; users not in this group lose admin on next login. Leave empty to use default behavior (first user is admin).
oidc.disablePasswordAuthHint: When enabled, only OIDC login is allowed. Make sure OIDC is working before enabling this.
oidc.testFailed: Failed to connect to OIDC provider

pending.description: Users awaiting approval to access the system
